result.instructions: Tools for Docupilot, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "List my published Docupilot templates."; "Which merge fields does my invoice template need?"; "Show the documents that failed to generate this week.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Docupilot data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run docupilot_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run docupilot_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run docupilot_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. docupilot_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: docupilot_get_current_user
tools.title: Get current user
tools.description: Show the Docupilot user that owns the API key (name, email). Use it to check the connection.

tools.name: docupilot_list_templates
tools.title: List templates
tools.description: List document templates in the workspace (paginated: count, next, results). Filter by title search, status (active = published, test = unpublished), template type, output type or folder id.

tools.name: docupilot_get_template
tools.title: Get template
tools.description: Get one template: title, type, folder, published state, preferences and timestamps.

tools.name: docupilot_get_template_schema
tools.title: Get template schema
tools.description: List the merge fields (variables) a template expects, with their types. Use it to learn what data a template needs.

version_id.description: Template version: a numeric version id, "latest" or "live".

tools.name: docupilot_list_template_versions
tools.title: List template versions
tools.description: List the saved versions of a template (paginated).

tools.name: docupilot_list_template_deliveries
tools.title: List template deliveries
tools.description: List the delivery methods set up on a template (email, webhook, cloud storage, e-signature).

tools.name: docupilot_list_folders
tools.title: List folders
tools.description: List the template folders in the workspace. Filter by the permission the user has (read or write).

tools.name: docupilot_list_merge_history
tools.title: List merge history
tools.description: List documents that were generated (merge history, newest first, paginated). Each row has template, status (pending, success, error), delivery type, file name, time and the input data. Filter by template, status, text or a date range.

start_date.description: Created on or after (yyyy-mm-dd or ISO date-time).

end_date.description: Created on or before (yyyy-mm-dd or ISO date-time).
